dominant_strengths: Clear typographic hierarchy with confident scale jump and tasteful violet gradient accent on the key phrase
Cohesive dark palette with consistent violet accent across icon, feature glyphs, and CTA glow
Tidy card-in-canvas composition with breathable rhythm between hero, feature list, and CTA
dominant_weaknesses: Extremely generic onboarding template — icon, three feature rows, gradient CTA — nothing memorable or category-defining
Feature row descriptions truncate with ellipses inside a roomy card, signaling weak content sizing rather than intentional restraint
The floating 'phone-shaped' container on a grid background reads like a mockup frame, undermining context and authenticity
fix_priorities: Inject a distinctive idea (live preview, animated demo, or content-driven hero) to escape default onboarding tropes
Fix truncated feature descriptions — either shorten copy or widen/restructure rows so text breathes properly
Resolve the container ambiguity: commit to either full-bleed web layout or a true device frame, not an in-between
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral polish and behavioral clarity are solid, but the reflective layer is thin — nothing here makes you remember Aura tomorrow.
rationale.intent_fit: Yes, it functions as an onboarding welcome screen, but it executes the genre rather than reinterpreting it.
